doc.title: Monthly Updates [December]
doc.html:
INFO These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our Commits Page on GitHub or Updates Channel in Discord.

Wiki Updates

  • Added new backup site FMHY.bid. Should be unblocked more places than .net currently.

  • Added new section for Photography / Cameras.

  • Added new section for 3D Printing / Printers.

  • Re-ordered AI Benchmarks, starred Kaggle Benchmarks, removed ones with dated testing, and added a subsection for Specialized Benchmarks. Before vs After / 2.

  • Re-ordered and cleaned up ugly formatting in Hosting Tools. Before vs After / 2.

  • Moved Browser Startpages + Custom New Tab Pages out of storage into their own sections.

  • Brought back the Website for FMHY SafeGuard.

Stars Added ⭐

  • Starred AnimeX in Anime Streaming. Feature-rich, solid sources, big library, nice UI, and has forums.

  • Starred Bing Image Creator in Image Gen. Gives 200 daily, has good editing, and seems to be the best way to use GPT Image 1 as of now.

  • Starred TizenTube Cobalt in Android TV. Ad-free YouTube app, updated often, has SponsorBlock support, and uses the official YouTube UI.

  • Starred Watch Footy in Live Sports. Solid sources, nice UI, and lots of events.

  • Starred Streamer.bot in Live Streaming Tools. Feature-rich live stream manager, compatible w/ OBS, Streamlabs, etc.

  • Starred RoSeal in Roblox Tools. Improves the Roblox website and adds nearly 200 extra features.

  • Starred Voice in Android Audiobook Players. Open-source, multi-format, has cover fetch, and a nice minimal design.

  • Starred Loop Habit Tracker in Mobile Productivity. Open-source, has sticky notifications, and better limits than most free options.

  • Re-starred CDRomance in ROM Sites as it's made a comeback. Note that RetroGamingTalk accounts will work on CDRomance.

Things Removed

  • Removed Anadius as they've decided to step down / 2. It may be re-added in the future if someone new steps up to maintain it.

  • Removed ContextSearch as it's been removed by Firefox. It seems to be causing issues, and in some cases flooding sites with requests. We're unsure if it's purposefully malicious or a mistake by its developer, but regardless, it's recommended to remove it and try other options like ContextSearch web-ext.

  • Unstarred Files in File Managers. There was a lot of hype for this originally, but people have started to come forward saying it's too laggy / slow to be useful.

  • Unstarred Grok, Qwen, Mage, and Flux.1 Schnell in Image Gen. These were considered good in the past, but there are much better, less-dated free options at this point.
